title: MediaMart: an AI assistant for electronics sales and customer care
summary: An AI assistant for electronics sales and customer care, handling first responses and exceptions consistently.

blocks.text: Electronics customers ask a lot about products, orders and delivery, and need fast responses that still follow policy.

items: Many repeated questions about products, order status and delivery.
Exceptions must be passed to staff at the right time.
The care tone must be consistent across channels.

blocks.text: I was Product Owner: classifying sales and care scenarios, organizing the knowledge base, and designing conversation flows and exception-handling rules.

items: Cases outside the script go to staff with full context.
Customers know where their order is without waiting.

blocks.alt: Illustration: a care conversation and order status
blocks.caption: Illustration: a care conversation and order status

items: A fast first response makes customers feel looked after.
Well-designed exceptions make customers trust the whole system.
